meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Signal 接入为你手机的「第二个设备」：通过 signal-cli 用你手机上已有的号码收发消息，不注册新号、不用 bot API。支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复、私聊打字提示；未支持外发文件、编辑/删除消息、表情回应。
howto.when: 当你要求给助手添加 Signal 频道、链接 Signal 账号，或正在走 /setup 流程需要接入 Signal 时，它会接管安装、扫码链接与接线步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接进来，用 signal-cli 扫码链接我的手机号
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并显示二维码等待扫码

say.text: 我扫完码了，把链接到的号码存下来并重启服务
say.note: 写入 SIGNAL_ACCOUNT 后重启，适配器绑定该账号

say.text: 把这个 Signal 群接到我的 agent 分组上
say.note: 用 ncl wirings create 创建接线

howto.what_en: Claude connects Signal as a secondary device: it sends and receives through signal-cli as the number already on your phone, with no new number and no bot API. Markdown, quoted replies, and DM typing indicators are supported; outbound files, edits/deletes and reactions are not yet.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to add a Signal channel or link a Signal account, or when the /setup flow needs Signal wired in.

say_en.text: Add Signal using signal-cli and link my phone by QR code
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and shows a QR code to scan

say_en.text: I scanned it — save the linked number and restart the service
say_en.note: Writes SIGNAL_ACCOUNT and binds the adapter to it

say_en.text: Wire this Signal group to my agent group
say_en.note: Creates the wiring with ncl wirings create
